messages:
maria: quick heads-up — opened a tiny docs PR to clean up the audit/evidence export wording and to add one TS + one Go SDK example. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4023 :eyes:
chris: thanks — skimmed. two quick nits: 1) the retention phrasing sounds permanent, can we use 'short-lived for debugging & compliance' instead? 2) the link to KMS is 404 (line ~72).
jordan: pushed a small code tweak to the TS snippet to align with the runtime API. diff included in the PR. snippet looks like:
```ts
// example: exportAuditRecords.ts
import { AuditClient } from '@redwood/inference-sdk';
const c = new AuditClient({ region: 'us-west-2' });
await c.export({ tenantId: 'acme', from: '2024-10-01', to: '2024-10-31' });
```
maria: perfect — can you add a short comment about redaction behavior in that snippet? e.g., 'PII fields are redacted per tenant policy' so folks understand it's not a raw dump.
jordan: added the comment and a one-liner about TTLs. left a TODO to link the retention table.
legal_liz: quick legal check — for SOC2 phrasing, prefer: 'Exported audit artifacts are retained only as required for investigation and contractual obligations; default retention is 30 days unless a longer legal hold is asserted.' avoids 'temporary' vague language. please put that exact sentence in the docs paragraph.
maria: good call. i'll replace the sentence. also we need to be explicit about redaction: callers should not rely on exports for PII removal guarantees — retention + redaction are separate controls.
sam: question — do we need to mention KMS key rotation in this doc? ops asked if customers should rotate keys before export. my take: link to KMS lifecycle page and note that exported files are encrypted with the customer's active key at time of export.
chris: agree with sam. add a small note and move the KMS link to the security section. i can fix the 404.
dev-docs-bot: PR #4023 updated by jordan — added TS comment & retention link (commit 9f3b2c). CI: docs-lint passed.
maria: thanks everyone. plan: i will land after 1pm PT today if no objections. @legal_liz if you can drop an ack once the phrasing is in place that would be great.
legal_liz: ack, phrasing submitted in the latest commit. LGTM from legal.
maria: merging in 30m unless anything else. :rocket:
